errors.text_span: 前段为蓝色圆点，后段叠加为蓝色星形标记
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the star markers are superimposed on the circular markers. In the figure, the markers are blue circles for the first four epochs (1-4) and then change to blue stars for the subsequent epochs (5-30). There is no superposition of markers.
